title: Moradabad Couple Found Dead In River; Suspected Honour Killing; Two Arrested; Probe Underway
text: Moradabad Couple Found Dead In River; Suspected Honour Killing; Two Arrested; Probe UnderwayBodies of a couple have been recovered from a river in Umri Sabjipur in a suspected honour killing case in Moradabad; The victims, from different communities, have been identified. Police have stepped up deployment, and forensic teams are collecting evidence while post-mortems are underway. Two accused have been taken into custody.
